tools.name: synthesize_neural_search
tools.description: Executes multi-domain semantic search query expansion, relevance re-ranking, and extractive factual snippet bundling. Use when retrieving grounded web knowledge, evaluating search results across diverse domains, and retrieving cited answers; for building deep research briefings, use compile_research_dossier instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'search_query' ('search_mode' defaults to 'hybrid_semantic_keyword'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

search_query.description: Primary search query, factual question, or technical topic to search.

search_mode.description: Information retrieval strategy: hybrid semantic keyword, strict fact retrieval, or deep research.

max_results.description: Maximum number of ranked result snippets to synthesize.

tools.name: compile_research_dossier
tools.description: Compiles multi-source factual research briefs with verified citations, confidence intervals, and key analytical takeaways. Use when synthesizing comprehensive intelligence briefings on complex technical, scientific, or market developments; for rapid query search snippets, use synthesize_neural_search instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'research_topic' ('depth_level' defaults to 'executive_brief'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (35 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

research_topic.description: Complex subject, market sector, emerging technology, or policy topic to research.

depth_level.description: Research dossier rigor: executive brief, deep investigation, or technical whitepaper.

target_citations.description: Target number of primary citations to identify and verify.

annotations.title: Deep Research Dossier & Citation Intelligence Brief

tools.name: expand_search_queries
tools.description: Generates targeted Boolean queries, semantic synonym variations, and sub-question expansions from an ambiguous prompt. Use when overcoming query vocabulary mismatches and expanding search recall across academic, code, or patent databases; for scoping queries to domain categories, use filter_domain_intelligence instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'base_query' ('expansion_strategy' defaults to 'boolean_operators'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

base_query.description: Initial search prompt or ambiguous question requiring semantic query expansion.

expansion_strategy.description: Query expansion method: Boolean operators, semantic synonyms, or cross-domain questions.

target_count.description: Target count of query variations to synthesize.

annotations.title: High-Entropy Boolean & Semantic Search Query Expander

tools.name: filter_domain_intelligence
tools.description: Scopes search execution and filters results strictly across verified high-reputation domain registries and regulatory bodies. Use when restricting search discovery to verified academic papers, SEC filings, official documentation, or legal statutes; for checking specific factual claims, use verify_factual_claims instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'query' ('domain_tier' defaults to 'academic_and_research'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

query.description: Topic or query to execute across specialized domain registries.

domain_tier.description: Curated domain authority tier: academic and research, regulatory and legal, tech docs, or financial.

annotations.title: Curated Domain Registry Scope & Source Authority Filter

tools.name: analyze_news_recency
tools.description: Tracks breaking news feeds, clusters trending story cycles, and calculates story publication velocity over recent timeframes. Use when analyzing breaking market catalysts, emerging controversies, or ongoing product announcements; for evaluating sentiment polarity across media, use analyze_media_sentiment instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'topic' ('recency_window' defaults to 'past_24_hours'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

topic.description: Subject, ticker symbol, brand, or public event to scan for breaking news developments.

recency_window.description: News timestamp search window: past hour, past 24 hours, past 7 days, or past 30 days.

sentiment_cluster.description: Whether to calculate sentiment direction across news story clusters.

annotations.title: Real-Time News Recency, Trending Story Clusters & Velocity Tracker

tools.name: verify_factual_claims
tools.description: Audits factual statements against authoritative consensus sources and assigns truthfulness scores with counter-evidence. Use when checking disputed claims, detecting AI hallucinations, or validating quotes before citation; for formatting academic citations, use extract_scholarly_citations instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'claim_statement' ('verification_rigor' defaults to 'multi_source_consensus'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

claim_statement.description: Factual assertion, statistic, or quote requiring independent source verification.

verification_rigor.description: Fact verification method: multi-source consensus, official records only, or probabilistic check.

context_domain.description: Optional domain context such as economics, medicine, history, or computer science.

tools.name: extract_scholarly_citations
tools.description: Formats academic paper metadata and DOI identifiers into standard scholarly citation formats (BibTeX, APA, IEEE, MLA). Use when generating bibliographies for research papers, validating journal references, or resolving DOI identifiers; for structuring research timelines, use summarize_temporal_timeline instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'source_content_or_doi' ('citation_style' defaults to 'bibtex_format'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

source_content_or_doi.description: DOI string, arXiv ID, or raw paper title with author list to format into citation.

citation_style.description: Bibliographic citation standard: BibTeX format, APA 7th edition, IEEE standard, or MLA 9th edition.

include_abstract.description: Whether to include publication abstract in structured metadata.

annotations.title: Scholarly Citation Compiler (BibTeX, APA, IEEE, MLA) & DOI Resolver

tools.name: cluster_topic_subgraphs
tools.description: Discovers latent thematic clusters, subtopic branches, and conceptual relationships across document corpora. Use when structuring broad search results into distinct thematic silos or generating table of contents taxonomies; for tracking chronological milestones, use summarize_temporal_timeline instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'documents_or_queries' ('clustering_method' defaults to 'tf_idf_semantic_graph'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

documents_or_queries.description: Newline-separated list or JSON array of text snippets, queries, or article abstracts.

clustering_method.description: Thematic clustering algorithm: TF-IDF semantic graph, centroid k-means, or hierarchical taxonomy.

max_clusters.description: Maximum number of thematic cluster groups to partition data into.

annotations.title: Semantic Topic Clustering & Subgraph Taxonomy Synthesizer

tools.name: analyze_media_sentiment
tools.description: Evaluates brand, market, or topic sentiment across news headlines, discussions, and articles with bull/bear polarity scores. Use when assessing market sentiment, social brand perception, or controversy exposure on specific entities; for compiling competitive market comparisons, use compile_competitive_landscape instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text_or_headlines' ('sentiment_domain' defaults to 'general_news'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

text_or_headlines.description: Collection of headlines, commentary strings, or editorial paragraphs to evaluate.

sentiment_domain.description: Lexicon domain weighting: general news, financial markets, or developer ecosystem.

entity_filter.description: Optional specific brand, company, or coin name to isolate sentiment around.

annotations.title: Multi-Source Media Sentiment & Bull/Bear Polarity Oracle

tools.name: rank_expert_sources
tools.description: Identifies and ranks top domain authorities, leading researchers, and primary documentation repositories for technical topics. Use when finding primary source experts to cite or discovering foundational documentation for specialized fields; for ranking general search query snippets, use synthesize_neural_search instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'subject_area' ('authority_metric' defaults to 'pagerank_and_domain_authority'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

subject_area.description: Academic field, open source framework, protocol, or technical discipline to explore.

authority_metric.description: Reputation evaluation standard: PageRank and domain authority, citation h-index, or code repo stars.

max_experts.description: Maximum number of top domain authorities to return in the ranking.

annotations.title: Domain Expert Authority Ranking & Primary Source Discovery

tools.name: summarize_temporal_timeline
tools.description: Synthesizes chronological milestone timelines from search results, news archives, and historical documents. Use when reconstructing historical events, tracking company histories, or mapping regulatory progression; for tracking real-time breaking news in the past 24 hours, use analyze_news_recency instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'event_corpus' ('timeline_resolution' defaults to 'chronological_milestones'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

event_corpus.description: Unstructured text corpus containing dated events, news reports, or historical accounts.

timeline_resolution.description: Temporal event grouping: chronological milestones, daily chronicle, or weekly epochs.

ascending_order.description: Whether to sort timeline from oldest to newest (true) or reverse chronological (false).

annotations.title: Chronological Event Timeline Compiler & Milestone Synthesizer

tools.name: compile_competitive_landscape
tools.description: Compiles multi-competitor comparison matrices, pricing tiers, feature coverage, and strategic moat evaluations. Use when analyzing market landscapes, evaluating pricing parity, or conducting diligence on competing product offerings; for compiling narrative research briefs, use compile_research_dossier instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'target_entity_or_market' ('analysis_framework' defaults to 'feature_and_pricing_matrix'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

target_entity_or_market.description: Industry sector, product category, or target company to benchmark against competitors.

analysis_framework.description: Benchmarking framework: feature and pricing matrix, SWOT competitive moat, or market share quadrant.

max_competitors.description: Maximum number of market competitors to profile and contrast.

annotations.title: Competitor Intelligence, Feature Matrix & Moat Analyzer
